title: Is a hot dog a sandwich?
titleHtml: Is a hot dog a sandwich?
sub: Nine golfers vote, a hot dog scoreboard keeps count, and the final score lands at the end.

title: Mayo or sand?

title: Guess the 50-50
sub: Twelve golfers guess what the 2025 50-50 hit, lowest to highest. The video ends on the question, with no answer.
note: When people comment their guesses, hold off on posting the real 2025 total until the number is confirmed in writing.
